limitations: Exploratory development tasks and handcrafted rules; one reworded SQL prompt is not a held-out dataset.
Scopes are provided by the caller; there is no automatic domain or no-match classifier.
Top-1 always selects a rule within a nonempty active scope; no relevance threshold.
Cyber retrieval uses the current task text, not the entire previous coder conversation.
Replaying stored coder tokens is not a fresh multi-step CGR DAG run.
